title: Agentics Simulation Engine Governance Manifest
description: Declarative governance manifest for the agentics-simulation-engine repository. Defines which organizations, environments, and roles can initiate simulations, view live simulation outputs, or access completed simulation results. This is a purely declarative governance document - it does not contain simulation logic, behavior parameters, or execution code.

id.description: Unique simulation governance manifest identifier (UUID v4, immutable)

repository.description: Fixed repository identifier for simulation engine governance

organizationId.description: Organization that owns this governance manifest

description.description: Human-readable description of the simulation governance requirements

simulationInitiation.description: Governance for who can initiate/trigger simulations

simulationOutputVisibility.description: Governance for who can view simulation outputs (live and completed)

resourceBoundaries.description: Declarative resource boundaries for simulation execution (governance, not configuration)

effectiveDate.description: Date when this governance becomes effective

expirationDate.description: Date when this governance expires (null for no expiration)

observedAt.description: When this governance state was observed

dataSource.description: Authoritative source of this governance data

initiatorGrants.description: Access grants for entities permitted to initiate simulations

defaultDeny.description: If true, simulation initiation is denied unless explicitly granted

environmentRestrictions.description: Environments where simulations can be initiated (governance boundary)

auditRequirements.description: Audit logging requirements for simulation initiation

SimulationInitiationGovernance.description: Governance rules for simulation initiation authority

required.description: Whether approval is required before simulation can execute

approverRoles.description: Roles that can approve simulation requests

approvalEnvironments.description: Environments where approval is required (may differ from general environments)

autoApproveConditions.description: Conditions under which auto-approval is permitted (declarative)

liveSimulationObservers.description: Access grants for entities that can observe live simulation progress

completedSimulationReaders.description: Access grants for entities that can read completed simulation results

visibilityBoundary.description: Organizational boundary for simulation output visibility

resultRedaction.description: Redaction rules for simulation results based on viewer role

SimulationOutputVisibility.description: Governance rules for simulation output visibility

sensitiveMetricPaths.description: JSON paths to metrics that should be redacted for non-privileged viewers

aggregationRequired.description: Whether raw results must be aggregated before visibility to certain roles

minimumAggregationSize.description: Minimum number of records to aggregate for privacy (if aggregationRequired)

SimulationResultRedaction.description: Declarative redaction rules for simulation results

byEnvironment.description: Maximum concurrent simulations per environment (governance limit)

byRole.description: Maximum concurrent simulations per role (governance limit)

auditLogRetentionDays.description: Days to retain audit logs (may differ from results)

ResourceBoundaries.description: Declarative resource boundaries (governance, not runtime configuration)
